ideas.idea: Add concrete details (dates, prices, duration, location, booking) to the classes page
ideas.why: classes.html only says 'Book early', so adding specifics gives people and machines actionable information.
The brief says having no JSON-LD is not a required fix, so recommending it contradicts that.

ideas.idea: Add opening hours and collection details on the home page
ideas.why: index.html promises weekend pre-order collection but gives no where or when.

ideas.idea: List breads individually with names, availability and details
ideas.why: breads.html mentions 'over twenty loaves' but names only two, so a per-loaf list adds real content.

ideas.idea: Put actual allergen information and a contact route in text
ideas.why: The data-nosnippet on the allergen notice is a deliberate scoped choice, and this asks to rework that notice.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph/Twitter social preview metadata
ideas.why: It is accurate because these tags are absent, but it applies to nearly any site and does little for discovery.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod dates to sitemap entries
ideas.why: It is accurate and mildly helpful, but it is standard advice for any sitemap.

ideas.idea: Consider a labeled entry point to /members for authenticated users
ideas.why: It is conditional ('only if intended') and not tied to any finding in the files.
